title: Extension of a pulled coherent formal system to a fixed proper compactification
statement: Let $S,Z,Y,X$ be schemes, with $Z,Y,X$ Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $f:Z\to S$ be separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $J$ a quasi-coherent ideal on $S$, and $Q=J\mathcal O_Z$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Let $G$ be a coherent formal $Q$-module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] whose level $1$ support is proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Let $q:Y\to Z$ and $p:X\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $j:Y\to X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], with $pj=fq$. There exists a coherent formal $J\mathcal O_X$-module $H$ whose termwise tensor pullback along $j$ is isomorphic to the termwise tensor pullback of $G$ along $q$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. This is extension of a formal system only; neither completion of a coherent module nor adic completeness is asserted.

source.place: Theorem Tag 088E, theorem-grothendieck-existence, proof: paragraph after Chow’s lemma, through formation of the extended coherent formal system; Lemma Tag 0CYJ, lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open

proof.text: Obtain the formal pullback functor P along q. Its equality with termwise tensor pullback determines F = P(G) as the pulled system. Choose the closed support R at level op 0 from hR. Proper inverse-image stability gives RY = q inverse image R proper over S. Its image T under j is closed in X by separatedness of p, and T lies in the range of j.

Coherence at level op 0 implies quasi-coherence and finite type. The finite-type support pullback theorem identifies the support of F at op 0 with RY. Constancy of formal-system support identifies every level with that support, so each lies in j inverse image T.

Use comap_comp, hj and hQ to identify (J.comap p).comap j with Q.comap q. The closed-support direct-image lemma proves that the concrete system F.obj composed with pushforward j satisfies the coherent formal object conditions. Package this system and that proof as H.

The tensor pullback and restriction functors are left adjoints of pushforward j, hence uniquely naturally isomorphic. The restriction adjunction counit is an isomorphism. Whisker this counit comparison by F.obj, use associators and the right unitor, and compose with the equality identifying F.obj with the tensor pullback of G.obj. This gives the required system isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chow_formal_system_extension
    {S Z Y X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian X]
    (f : Z ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (J : S.IdealSheafData) (Q : Z.IdealSheafData) (hQ : Q = J.comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper q] (p : X ⟶ S) [IsProper p]
    (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hj : j ≫ p = q ≫ f) :
    ∃ H : CoherentFormalModule X (J.comap p),
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        H.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback j)
